items.text: Asks how the design handles gradual rollout and rollback when SSO failures affect availability.
Notes missing consideration for IdP performance variability and recommends circuit breakers to prevent cascading failures.
Questions how user consent is obtained and documented for account linking across identity providers.
Identifies missing disaster recovery plan for when primary IdPs are unavailable for extended periods.
Asks about monitoring for suspicious linking patterns that might indicate coordinated account takeover attempts.
Notes that configuration stored in YAML files violates the twelve-factor app principle of storing config in environment.
Questions how the design handles token binding to prevent token replay across different clients or devices.
Asks about data residency implications when IdPs and user data span different regulatory jurisdictions.

weakAnswers: The design looks comprehensive and covers the main requirements.
Consider adding more details about scalability and performance.
Make sure to follow security best practices throughout implementation.
The document is well-structured but could use more diagrams.
Good start, just need to consider edge cases and error handling.
